book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso sɛɛŋ lɛ ba lé ba gê ba sa yeh yi kintanyɛ
Jiso bu yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu doo wu gɛɛne, booŋ be ba ŋgoo kɛŋsɛ bo to mbebe ye le bo duunyi yéh yi fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le wu le.
Geenɛ, Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛde yéh chinɛ le? Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ tɛdɛ chimimia nyu chi shɛɛ yi chimi le njɛ ba kɛsɛ chi fɛkuu sɛŋ gɛ.”

content: Jiso doo wu gɛɛŋ wu bɛɛŋ wu shii yi Mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le, booŋ be ba ŋgoo kɛŋsɛ bo to lɛbolɛbo fɛ wu le bo biih lɛ, “Gɛh sɛɛŋ bee kife kì fiɛɛ fiyu finɛ lé fi gê fì kooshɛ, mo njiŋɛ wù lé wu gê wu dûnyɛ kife kì wo lé wo gê wo kaasɛ wo to mo no lɛ woŋ kage wa lo?”

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne keefɛ muh to wu lɛɛ bɛ bɛŋ, bɛŋ jiaa je gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ bamii ba duude lé bo gê bo too bo jode jee chaŋ bo tɛyi fɛ jii, muh duu lɛ wu le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka. Bo doo bo gee noo bo lɛɛde bɛ bamii ba duude bo jiaade je.

Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ yuge lɛ ba tune jɛŋ, bɛŋ ka yuge tɛ basaaka lɛ jɛŋ le yi nyume. Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ yuge noo, keefɛ fitele gûde bɛŋ gɛ. Munɛ lé mwɛɛ mù kɛme ki mu gê mu kooshɛ. Geenɛ gɛ mu mo duunyi lɛ woŋ kage wa lo gɛ.
Kituŋ lé ki gê ki tune jɛŋ bɛ kimi, nfoŋ wumu tune jɛŋ bɛ wumu. Jɛŋ lé yi gê yi koode, nshɛŋ lé yi gê yi shîiŋshi manjuu le manjuu le.
Mwɛɛ munɛ munchii baaŋ gɛh lo nsasɛ njɛ sege kwɛse kɛ lume.
Bamii lé bo gê bo nya bɛŋ ba nyiɛge bɛ bɛŋ, ba yuuyɛ bɛŋ. Bituŋ bichii lé bi gê bi banɛ bɛŋ nje jee chaŋ.
Noo, bamii ba duude mo bo chii bikaa a mɛ jiŋ, bo banɛ bikwɛɛ biboo, bo gese bikwɛɛ biboo.
Bamii ba duude ba mbiane lɛ tuŋ Nyo bo, bo lé bo jâ bo bunɛ bo lɛɛde bɛ bamii wesee.
No kimbefɛ lé ki gê ki duude ki gɛɛne lo fwe, ki ge kiŋkoŋɛ ki bamii ba duude mo ki tu wɛɛ.
Geenɛ, muh wù lé wu gê wu kaaŋ shɛ́ŋ gɛɛŋ bu fɛkimɛsɛ lé wù gê wu bonɛ.
Bo kɛme gɛh ki bo ge bo fêjɛ saaka wù joŋe wunɛ wù kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo gɛɛŋ bu yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le kichii bituŋ bichii yu, noo, fɛ woŋ ge wu ka.

content: N'yɛyɛ kune kife ki ŋgɛ wù baaŋ

content.text: Noo sege bɛŋ yɛŋ kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ kì taŋlo ki chɛŋɛ bɛ kijusɛ kì muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Danyɛ gɛ̀ jɛme kune ki, ki lɛme wa yeh yi kintanyɛ le, muh wù tɛŋe ŋwa wunɛ yu finɛ chuule,
bamii ba le Judia mo bo fɛɛ lo bo bɛɛŋ yi bambegɛ le.
Keefɛ muh wù le kigo ki yeh le ka wu shii wu lee ki wu jô fiɛɛ fì le yeh gɛ.
Keefɛ muh wu le mwɛne ka wu kaase wu kwɛɛde lɛ wu to ki wu jô kikuŋ wu noŋ ye le gɛ.
Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le yi aju kaa le, lé wu gê wù nyu wu bikɛse ba le bɛ chifwe, mo ba yaŋse booŋ.
Bɛŋ bûune lɛ keefɛ kinlegɛ kinɛ ki nyû yi kife ki nfuŋ le, kɛnɛ juu chi yuuŋ gɛ,
nje ŋgɛ wù baaŋ lé wu gê wu nyûme kife kɛɛ le, kfuu chi wu wɛɛ ŋgɛ gɛ̀ baaŋ a nyu gɛ yu gɛ, kɛge no woŋ gɛ̀ kɛ too bude mɛɛse, gɛ kfuu chi wu wɛɛ baaŋ wu ka wu yu wù nyu yu gɛ.
Nɛ Nyo gɛ̀ baaŋ gade gɛ aju a ŋgɛ ayu gɛ, tu muh wu wuŋ wu mumwaa bee gɛ wu bonɛ gɛ. Geenɛ wu gɛ̀ gade aju ayu nje bamii be ba wu gɛ̀ cha.
Lé doo nyûme sege kɛɛ nɛ muh lé wu jɛ̂mɛ bɛŋ le lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka nɛ wu wunɛ fɛnɛ!’ Kɛnɛ lɛ, ‘Nɛ wu wege fege!’ Keefɛ bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋ gɛ.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ bamii lé bo gê bo too bo mbiane lɛ bo le bambvusɛ ba Nyo gɛ̀ ka, bamu duu lɛ bo le bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo, bo mo bo gee mwɛɛ mù tɛɛme mù duunyi bvuŋga bvuboo, bo gee tɛ mwɛɛ mù jwe yune, ki bo lɛ̂ɛde bɛ bamii bo jiaade je, bo lɛ̂ɛde mo tɛ bɛ bamii ba Nyo gɛ̀ cha wa, nɛ je le yu.
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, nle nsɛɛŋ wa mwɛɛ munɛ bɛŋ le fɛ mu ge mu kooshi.
Noo, bamii ja bo duu bɛŋ le lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka nɛ wu wege chvuuŋ’, keefɛ bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ fo gɛ. Kɛnɛ lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, nɛ wu wunɛ yeh antɛŋ’, keefɛ bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋ bo le gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ no jaŋ to yi lale we kimbe kì juu saane le, yi baaŋ yi gɛɛŋ yi bu a juu seele yo, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no nto wu muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu nyûme.
‘Mo nyu faaŋ fɛ gvunɛ chi fiɛɛ to chi nyume fo, le gɛh fo fɛ baŋgvuluŋ to bo taashi fo.’

content: Kune no Jiso lé wu gê wu tô

content.text: Kimimia, sege kife ki ŋgɛ wù baaŋ wunɛ to wa ki fe, juu ja gɛh nɛ chi jimɛ, kwii gɛ ka wu baaŋ gɛ, jóŋ jade fɛwe yi gweeyi, mwɛɛ mù fɛwe munchii mù kɛme bvuŋga shiiŋshi.

Njiŋɛ wu muh wù jee che le Mwamuh mo wu bunɛ yi kibvulɛ le. Bituŋ bichii bi yi nshɛŋ le mo bi kɛ bi fuge lo bɛ kwe. Bamii lé bo gê bo yɛŋ no muh wù jee che le Mwamuh too yi kimbɛ le fɛwe bɛ bvuŋga mo bvukugɛ bvù baaŋ.
Sege soŋ yì baaŋ ge doo yi jɛmɛ fɛwɛɛwe, wu mo wu chiiŋsɛ banchɛndaa be bo gɛɛŋ abu a woŋ le ana mo fɛwe, bo banyɛ bamii be ba wu le wu cha wa.
Bɛŋ yɛ̂yɛ fiɛɛ yi kiŋgvuŋ le. Chɛ́ too yi boji, biŋkamɛ kɛ bi choone yi chɛ́ yiyu le, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛɛ lɛ akfuuŋ kuse wa.
Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bɛŋ ge doo bɛŋ yɛne mwɛɛ munɛ le munchii, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kêe lɛ wu le wa mbebe le, mo a yeh fwɛɛŋ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ kiŋgogɛ ki mɛɛse kinɛ nyu ki to ki ka, njɛ mwɛɛ munɛ munchii kooshɛ sɛŋ gɛ.
Kibvulɛ bɛ nshɛŋ lé ki tô ki ka, geenɛ gɛ̀ jɛ yaŋ nyu yi to yi shiiŋshɛ gɛ.

content: Gɛ muh nyu yu wù kee juu chì Jiso lé wu gê wu tô gɛ

content.text: Geenɛ gɛ muh nyu yu wù kee juu chiyu kɛnɛ kife kiyu gɛ. Gɛ banchɛndaa ba Nyo ba fɛwe kɛnɛ Mwa Nyo kee tɛ gɛ. Kee gɛh Nyo wù Chiji maa.
Gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fi gɛ̀ bee kife ki Nyua le, nyu gɛh no fi lé fi gê fi nyume kife kì muh wù jee che le Mwamuh kaase wu too.

Gɛ̀ bee joo baaŋ a yisɛ gɛ yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le gɛ, bamii nyu fiboo bo jii mwɛɛ bo ka muu, bikɛse bɛ bilɛŋsɛ taashi bvuguu, bamii nyaa booŋ ba bilɛŋsɛ bo taashi bvuguu bɛ bo, gɛɛŋ bu juu chì Nyua gɛ̀ lesɛ a ŋguh le,

bamii bayu gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì lé fi kôoshɛ gɛ̀, gɛɛŋ bu sege joo gɛ̀ yisɛ yi nshɛŋ le, yi kudɛ bo bachii yi gɛɛŋ bɛ bo. Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fi lé fi gê fi nyume juu chì muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu tô.
Bilɛŋsɛ bafɛɛ lé bo nyû mwɛne, ba jô wu mumwaa wu mumwaa shɛ̂ɛ.
Bikɛse bafɛɛ lé bo gê bo goge bvulɛɛŋ fɛ jɛɛŋ, ba jô wu mumwaa wu mumwaa shɛ̂ɛ.
Noo, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ chîɛɛne nje gɛ bɛŋ kee juu chì Tada wene lé wu gê wu tô gɛ.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ chiji yeh nɛ kee kife kì choŋ lé wu gê wu tô antaŋ, wu chîɛɛne, wu gɛ ka wu chinɛ lɛ wu to wu ŋgode yeh ye gɛ.
Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, bɛŋ tɛ kɛme ki bɛŋ chîɛɛne nje muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu kaasɛ wu to kife kì bɛŋ kee gɛ le.

content: N'yɛyɛ kune mwa lɛme wù nchiɛɛŋ mo wù le gɛ wù nchiɛɛŋ gɛ

content.text: Mwa lɛme wù le wù nchiɛɛŋ wù ka kɛme bvufee le wù la? Gɛ nyume muh wɛɛ wù chiji kikwɛɛ ke le wu gɛɛ wu lɛ wu jîiŋe fɛ yeh ye le, sege kife doo ki kojɛ, wu nya mwɛɛ munjile booŋ be ba lɛme le gɛ?
Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ lé ki gê ki nyume ki mwa lɛme wù chiji kikwɛɛ ke, sege wu doo wu too wu yɛŋ wù gee lɛme gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no wu bee ki wù gee.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ chiji kikwɛɛ ke lé wu gê wu bɛɛŋsɛ wu, wu jiiŋe fɛ mwɛɛ mwe le munchii.
Geenɛ, nɛ mwa lɛme wɛɛ ja wù kɛme kiŋge kì befe, wu jɛmɛ kikwɛɛ ke le lɛ, ‘Gɛ chiji kikwɛɛ kaŋ nyu wu yaŋsɛ wu kaasɛ wu to gɛ’,
wu mo wu kɛ wu suŋe booŋ ba lɛme bamu ba bɛ bo lɛne, wu jii mwɛɛ wu ka muu bɛ bamii ba yaane mbvuuŋ,
tu chiji kikwɛɛ ke lé wu gê wu ja gɛh wu bunɛ juu chimi chì wu be kwaji gɛ, bɛ kife kì wu be kee gɛ le.
Wu doo wu bu noo, wu mo wu gwoojɛ lo mwa ye wu lɛme wɛɛ, wu chiiŋsɛ wu wu gɛɛŋ wù nyu bɛ bamii ba jɛme yeye, bo gee yeye le, nyu fo fɛ bamii lé bo gê bo beede bo ŋgeji bige.”
